title: Cursor pagination
brief: The mobile client pages with a cursor instead of page numbers. Add page_after(items, cursor, size): up to size items from cursor, and the next cursor (None at the end).
tasks: Test that paging walks every item, size items at a time

expected.why: items[cursor:cursor + size - 1] returns size-1 items: a page of 2 holds 1, and with size=1 every page is empty and the cursor never advances, so a client loops forever.
The test only checks that the walk covers every item, which it does one item at a time too: it never asserts a page holds size items, so it passes with D1.
